MANCHE1.R1: The shooting order of the first round is determined by an official draw.
MANCHE1.R2: Each shooter must be present and ready when their name is called.

MANCHESUIV.R1: The shooting order is established from the lowest score to the highest.
MANCHESUIV.R2: In the event of a tie, the shooter who first reached that score will shoot first.
MANCHESUIV.R3: Any unjustified delay or absence may result in the shooter being skipped.
